tu.prop: The Spanish word “banco” can name either a financial institution or a seat.

tu.note: Keep verb and adjective agreement consistent with the person addressed; grammatical third person does not mean “he” or “she.”
tu.prop: “Usted” is the formal singular form of “you” in Spanish.

tu.prop: “Sobremesa” is the time spent talking at the table after a meal.

tu.prop: Depending on context, “pueblo” may refer to a settlement or to a people as a community.

tu.prop: The Spanish interjection “ojalá” expresses a strong hope or wish.
